title: Python EDHOC _edhoc_kdf produces wrong KEYSTREAM_2 and PRK_out vs RFC 9529
description:
## Bug

Python EDHOC KDF function `_edhoc_kdf()` in `python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py` produces incorrect derived key material when tested against RFC 9529 Appendix B trace vectors.

## Failing tests

- `test_keystream2_rfc9529` - KEYSTREAM_2 derivation produces wrong bytes
- `test_prk_exporter_rfc9529` - PRK_out derivation produces wrong bytes

## Passing tests (transcript hashes are correct)

- `test_th2_rfc9529` - PASSED
- `test_th3_rfc9529` - PASSED  
- `test_th4_rfc9529` - PASSED

## Root cause

The KDF implementation itself appears to be computing wrong output. The transcript hash inputs are correct (TH_2/3/4 all pass), so the issue is in how `_edhoc_kdf()` uses HKDF-Expand with the info parameter encoding.

## To reproduce

cd python
python3 -m pytest tests/crypto/test_edhoc.py::TestRfc9529TraceVectors -v

## Fix

Review `_edhoc_kdf()` info parameter CBOR encoding against RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2.
